label: Retained readings from Thomas Aquinas, De ente et essentia
summary: cap.1 [69872]: ens per se dicitur dupliciter, uno modo quod dividitur per decem genera, alio modo quod significat propositionum veritatem: The statement supplies source evidence for concrete-esse-in-re and the contrast in docs/notes/concrete-abstract.md. The categorical/propositional distinction still needs an explicit mapping to the case's world-indexed concrete–abstract partition to be used as a premise there.
